digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate voting and triage
propositions: A cancelled or timed-out job in the Gerrit Verified Gate casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names no job and gives no reason, requiring manual investigation of the run log to triage
The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message as '${STATUS}: ${url}' with no input for custom text, and its comment-only flag suppresses labels but re-posts the same canned message

Different failure causes (timeout vs selector step version skew) produce identical uninformative Verified -1 votes, making it impossible to distinguish whether the author needs to rebase or can safely recheck

The solution posts detailed triage information (job name, outcome type, duration, URL) as an additional SSH-based comment-only Gerrit review after the vote is already cast, with continue-on-error guards to preserve vote integrity
